name: tidepool.catalog.search
description: Search the music and podcast catalog by words in titles, artist, album, show and publisher names (case- and accent-insensitive; each query word must match the start of a word). Optional item_type narrows to track, album, artist, show or episode. Removed items are left out. For a member with the explicit filter on, explicit items are marked filtered and a filtered track's clean version (same title and artist) is included. Returns up to limit (default 20) results; total counts every match.
resource_target: bound family account

name: tidepool.catalog.get_item
description: Read one catalog item by ID: a track, album (with its tracks), artist (with albums), show or episode (chapters, notes, end-of-content marker, and the signed-in member's progress). Removed items stay readable with availability "removed". Unknown IDs return not_found.
resource_target: bound family account

name: tidepool.shows.get_episodes
description: List a show's episodes, newest first (default limit 30), with the signed-in member's progress on each.
resource_target: bound family account

name: tidepool.family.get
description: Read the family account: members (download counts are shown for your own row, and for every member when you are the plan manager, with what removing each member would end), open invitations, member slots, the plan in effect now, any scheduled plan change, and billing derived from the current virtual time (current period, the current and next invoice, and payment-due state with its 7-day grace period).
resource_target: bound family account

name: tidepool.members.list
description: List family members (role, age group, status, explicit filter) and invitations. is_you marks the signed-in member, whose member_id is the id for member-scoped tools.
resource_target: bound family account

name: tidepool.devices.list
description: List the devices signed in to a member's account, with Tidepool storage cap, used and free bytes, auto-download, and the 30-day offline check (last check-in and when downloads turn to needs_check). id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.history.list
description: List a member's listening sessions, newest first (default limit 50): device, item, start reason, speed, start and end positions, and any unverified speaker_hint. Sessions on a shared device appear under the account signed in on that device. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.progress.get
description: Read a member's episode progress (unplayed, in_progress with position, or played). Give episode_ids for specific episodes, show_id for one show, or neither for every episode with recorded progress (most recently updated first). Agent changes show set_by "agent" and the value they replaced. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.follows.list
description: List the shows a member follows with per-show auto-download (newest n episodes) and auto-delete (days after played) settings. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.upnext.get
description: Read a member's Up Next queue in order, with its list_version, each episode's progress and remaining time, download status per device, and the total remaining time at 1x speed. Remaining time is from the saved position for an in-progress episode, and the full duration for any other entry (a played episode plays again from the start). id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.downloads.list
description: List a member's downloads with status derived from the current virtual time: queued until its completion time, then downloaded; needs_check once the device is more than 30 days past its last check-in or a declined payment is past its grace period; removed when cancelled, removed, or auto-deleted. Removed downloads are left out unless include_removed is true. Also returns storage per device. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.library.list
description: List a member's saved tracks and albums, most recently saved first. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.playlists.list
description: List the playlists a member can see: their own, and other active members' shared or collaborative playlists. your_role says whether the member owns, collaborates on or only views each one. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.playlists.get
description: Read one playlist the member can see, with every track entry, who added it and when. A track that is explicit while the member's explicit filter is on stays in the playlist and is marked skipped_for_you. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.notifications.list
description: List a member's in-app notices, newest first (default limit 50): new episodes of followed shows, edits by others to their collaborative playlists, and declined payments (manager). id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.plan.preview_change
description: Quote a plan change without applying it, computed by the same rules plan.confirm_change applies at the current virtual time: whether it is an upgrade (applies at once; the prorated price difference for the rest of the current period is added to the next invoice), a downgrade (scheduled for the end of the current period, refused if active members plus open invitations exceed the new limit) or none (the plan in effect, which revokes any scheduled change), whether it is allowed (blocked_by explains why not), and the resulting next invoice.
resource_target: bound family account

name: tidepool.progress.set
description: Set a member's progress on one episode: state unplayed, in_progress (position_s required, 1 to the episode duration) or played. Records set_by "agent" with the value it replaced and adds no listening session. A position beyond the duration returns invalid_position. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.follows.add
description: Follow a show for a member, optionally with auto-download of the newest n episodes (0 = off, default 0) and auto-delete of played episodes after d days (default off). Auto-delete also applies to downloads of episodes already played, counted from when each was played or downloaded, whichever is later. Following a show already followed changes nothing; settings that differ from the existing follow return invalid_arguments (use follows.update_settings). id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.follows.remove
description: Unfollow a show for a member. The show's downloads are kept (and no longer auto-deleted) unless removed with downloads.remove. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.follows.update_settings
description: Change a followed show's settings. patch may set auto_download_count (0-10) and auto_delete_days (1-90, or null for off). A new auto-delete window applies to already-played downloads of the show, counted from when each was played or downloaded, whichever is later; a window that has already passed removes them now. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.upnext.set
description: Replace a member's whole Up Next queue with episode_ids in order (an empty list clears it). expected_list_version must equal the list_version from upnext.get; otherwise the App returns list_version_mismatch (separate from Core's expected_version check). Returns the new list_version. Removed episodes return unavailable. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.downloads.add
description: Download a track, album or episode to one of the member's devices. The item's bytes are reserved at once and the download completes one simulated minute later (status queued until completes_at). Exceeding the device's free Tidepool storage returns storage_full and changes nothing; a removed item returns unavailable; a device without offline storage returns unavailable; a payment past its grace period returns payment_due. An item already on the device returns the existing download with changed false. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.downloads.remove
description: Remove one of the member's downloads, or cancel it if still queued, releasing its reserved bytes. Returns the bytes freed. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.library.save
description: Save a track or album to a member's library. Saving an item already saved changes nothing; a removed item returns unavailable. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.library.unsave
description: Remove a saved track or album from a member's library. Fails with not_found if it is not saved. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.playlists.create
description: Create a playlist owned by the member, with a name, visibility (private, shared or collaborative), optional collaborators (other active members; they can add, remove and reorder tracks while the playlist is collaborative) and optional starting tracks in order. Removed tracks return unavailable. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.playlists.update_tracks
description: Edit a playlist's tracks as the member (its owner, or a collaborator while it is collaborative). operations apply in order: add (track_id, optional 1-based position; past the end appends), remove (track_id) and move (track_id to position). Added tracks record the member as their author. Optional expected_track_version must equal the playlist's track_version (list_version_mismatch otherwise). A track already in the playlist returns invalid_arguments. Returns the new track_version. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.playlists.update_settings
description: Change a playlist's settings as its owner. patch may set name, description, visibility and collaborators (the full new list). A collaborator or viewer returns forbidden. Removing a collaborator keeps the tracks they added. id must be the signed-in member; another member returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.members.invite
description: Plan manager only: invite a person to the family. id is the invitee's person_id from the run binding. An open invitation holds a member slot (counted against the smaller plan while a downgrade is scheduled), so accepting it never exceeds the limit. Errors: already_member, already_invited, too_many_members, forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: person_id of the person to invite

name: tidepool.members.remove
description: Plan manager only: remove a member (id) from the family. Their downloads are removed, their edit access to other members' collaborative playlists ends (tracks they added stay), and their own shared and collaborative playlists leave the family view. Returns the same counts family.get showed under if_removed. The manager cannot remove themself (forbidden).
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.filters.update
description: Plan manager only: change a member's explicit-content filter. id is the member whose filter changes; patch.explicit_filter is the new value. Returns the replaced value. Any other caller returns forbidden.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the family member this call affects (see family.get or members.list; is_you marks the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.plan.confirm_change
description: Plan manager only (id is the manager's own member_id; any other member returns forbidden): change the family plan, using the same rules as plan.preview_change. An upgrade applies at once and adds its prorated difference to the next invoice (refused with payment_due while a payment is due); a downgrade is scheduled for the end of the current period and is refused with too_many_members if active members plus open invitations exceed the new limit. Choosing the plan already in effect keeps it: a scheduled change is revoked (revoked_change), and with none scheduled the call returns invalid_arguments, as does repeating a downgrade already scheduled.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the plan manager making the change (the signed-in member).

name: tidepool.plan.revoke_change
description: Plan manager only (id is the manager's own member_id; any other member returns forbidden): cancel the scheduled plan change before it takes effect. Returns no_pending_change if none is scheduled.
resource_target: member named by id in the bound family account

id.description: member_id of the plan manager making the change (the signed-in member).
